subject.title: [Bug]: QA Docker proofs do not execute documented artifacts

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101045 as the canonical Docker QA proof fix for this issue once review remains clean?
rationale: The issue is member-authored, protected by the `maintainer` label, and already has an open closing PR with exact-head proof, so cleanup automation should not close the issue or create a competing repair branch before maintainer review.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Use the linked PR as the fix path and close this issue only after that PR merges or is otherwise resolved.

options.title: Request changes on the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers ask for narrower Docker proof, safer script wiring, or additional CI evidence on the existing PR.

options.title: Reject the current fix path
options.body: Redirect or close the linked PR only if maintainers decide these Docker artifact proofs should not be part of QA Lab core evidence.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR as the fix path and close this issue only after that PR merges or is otherwise resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the issue, owns recent scenario-history commits, and authored the open linked fix PR.
